description: Get a country's CV/resume conventions: whether a photo, date of birth, nationality or marital status belong on the CV, the date format and the usual CV language. Use before writing or reviewing a CV for a job in that country (e.g. "de", "fr", "nl", "se").

country.description: A country or UI locale, e.g. "de", "fr", "nl", "se".

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: get_takemeup_locale_cv_rules
title: CV conventions by country
